### 2026-10-13 – I created my first design for the marble run. Currently my Marble run pieces are modular; they stack on top of each other. I currently have a main, bridge, top funnel, and bottom collection and plan t

**8h**

I created my first design for the marble run. Currently my Marble run pieces are modular; they stack on top of each other. I currently have a main, bridge, top funnel, and bottom collection and plan to create a wavy bridge, spinner and maybe a jump.
